title: Spatial and Single-Cell Multi-Omics Analyses of T-Cell Subsets and Interactions in Melanoma Lymph Node Metastasis.
snippet: Melanoma is a highly immunogenic malignancy, yet responses to systemic therapy remain variable. title: Integrative Multi-Omics and Experimental Validation Define RELB as an Immune-Related Prognostic Driver in Ovarian Cancer.
snippet: Ovarian cancer (OC) is one of the most aggressive gynecological malignancies worldwide. The tumor microenvironment and transcriptomic alterations play important roles in OC progression and therapeutic response. title: Genomic Landscape and Clinical Actionability of Skin Adnexal Carcinomas.
snippet: Skin adnexal carcinomas (SACs) are rare and heterogeneous tumors with no established systemic treatment options and poor long-term survival rates in the advanced disease setting. title: Fingolimod Alleviates Neuroinflammation and Blood-Brain Barrier Disruption in Epilepsy by Upregulating S1PR5 and Inhibiting the Rho/ROCK/NF-κB Pathway.
snippet: This study aimed to clarify the role of sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor 5 (S1PR5) in epileptic pathogenesis and the mechanism by which fingolimod exerts anti-epileptic effects, with a focus on neuroinflammation and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption. title: Medulloblastoma Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Tumor Microenvironment Heterogeneity With High-Density Progenitor Cell Regions Correlating With High-Risk Disease.
snippet: No curative options are available for medulloblastoma (MB) in the relapse setting.
